Collect litter with HABO

Pick up litter where you live, on your own time, and see what you've collected add up. Set up your account once; after that, you just press Start.

Set up your account

You do this once.

Use an email you can open on this phone: your codes to sign in, and a copy of the waiver you sign, come there. It also matches your account to your HABO volunteer record, so all your hours are in one place.

The name you pick for yourself, for the map and the game. No one else can have it.

Litter types

The litter map

Each square is a twentieth of a mile (about 265 ft) on a side. Its colour is its latest Litter Index: the pounds collected there, for the miles walked and the time it took. Tap a square for its reading, the day it was collected, and who collected it.
